translationRepairs: He was posted as judicial aide on the Yizhou Observation Commission, then made magistrate of Lianshui County, and rose in time to Hanlin Academician.
He was posted as judicial aide on the Yizhou Observation Commission, then made magistrate of Laishui County, and rose in time to Hanlin Academician.
s0009 改淶水縣令 names Laishui County (淶水); Lianshui is a different place (漣水). The proposed Laishui corrects the romanization without other changes.
He was assigned as judicial aide to the Yizhou Observation Commission, then transferred to magistrate of Lianshui County, and was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin Academician.
He was assigned as judicial aide to the Yizhou Observation Commission, then transferred to magistrate of Laishui County, and was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin Academician.
The literal line likewise renders 淶水 as Lianshui; Laishui matches the Chinese toponym.
He was made Commissioner of Guozhou for Observation, built schools, and enrolled students.
He was made Commissioner of Gaozhou for Observation, built schools, and enrolled students.
s0096 改高州觀察使 is Gaozhou Observation Commissioner; Guozhou misreads 高. The proposed Gaozhou is correct.
He was transferred to Commissioner of Guozhou for Observation, built schools, and enrolled students.
He was transferred to Commissioner of Gaozhou for Observation, built schools, and enrolled students.
The literal English also has Guozhou for 高州; Gaozhou is the accurate reading.
